# 🎲 Gameplay Playtest Report

## Session
Commit, browser/device, viewport, board preset, player count and date.

## Scenarios
List move sequence and intended rule behavior.

## Observations
- Was the legal-move rule understood?
- Were bursts and ownership changes predictable?
- Was active-player state clear?
- Did the cascade finish in reasonable time?
- Could players identify endgame and winner?

## Defects
Use exact board fixtures and coordinates. Link reproducible issues.

## Conclusion
Strengths, friction, accessibility barriers and prioritized follow-ups. Do not infer broad player behavior from one session.
